interface.shortDescription: Four principles that reduce common LLM coding mistakes
interface.longDescription:
Karpathy-inspired behavioral guidelines for coding agents: Think Before Coding, Simplicity First, Surgical Changes, and Goal-Driven Execution.

Use them when writing, reviewing, or refactoring code to surface assumptions, avoid overcomplication, keep diffs focused, and turn tasks into verifiable success criteria. The skill content matches the guidelines in CLAUDE.md and the Cursor project rule.
defaultPrompt: Apply the four Karpathy guidelines before coding
Review this change for overcomplication and drive-by edits
Turn this task into verifiable success criteria
